newsitem.title: USA: Md. counties support Baltimore schools plan -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Md. counties support Baltimore schools plan -- paper.

text.p: Leaders from Maryland's six largest counties have agreed to a plan increasing funding for Baltimore schools in exchange for more state aid to the state's 23 counties, the Washington Post reported Monday.
The plan would add $44 million to counties' state aid package next year, increasing to a $70 million hike in each of the next four years for a total of about $325 million.
Prince George's and Montgomery counties would get the biggest share of the proposed increase, at $11.2 million and $8 million for the first year, respectively.
Legislative leaders said they were not sure how the deal could be financed, but suggestions ranged from tapping a budget surplus to raising cigarette taxes, the newspaper said.
